highlights: Owned and led development of ServiceAgent product end-to-end, including architecture, backend systems, authentication flows and shared platform modules.
Designed and developed a centralized authentication package using JWT-based authentication with rotating CSRF token strategy for secure multi-service integrations.
Built a reusable appointment scheduling npm package inspired by Cal.com architecture, designed to work across multiple products with isolated databases.
Built reusable npm packages adopted across multiple services to standardize business logic and accelerate development.
Led backend architecture discussions, production deployments and cross-team technical coordination for scalable TypeScript/NestJS services.
Worked on scalable distributed backend systems using TypeScript, NestJS, Redis and event-driven design patterns.
Led ABDM/ABHA/HPR/HFR integrations for DRx platform under National Health Authority initiatives.
Designed scalable solutions for SCMD and SDMC workflows to support multi-clinic and multi-doctor operational models.
Implemented scalable backend design patterns including Callback Pattern and Facade Pattern for reusable workflows.
Worked on Tookan, a large-scale delivery management platform used by global businesses for logistics and workforce management.
Designed and developed ACL systems to provide granular access control across derived but independent business entities.
Integrated backend services with POS systems, payment gateways, accounting software and eCommerce platforms.
